mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates below 0.25% compress discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as investors rotate into equities for yield.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness, prompting anticipatory rate cuts that drive positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise above 2.5% YoY indicates temporary inflation shock, triggering short-term equity rally as Fed delays tightening over 60 days.
failure_condition: Interaction fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors rotate into value stocks anticipating growth-supportive policy responses.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth above 105.0 (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days via earnings momentum.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,050,000 units (HOUST > 1050) signal strong consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days via sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns negative in >55% of instances when HOUST > 1050, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline indicate tight labor market, accelerating wage inflation and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days via Fed tightening expectations.
failure_condition: Interaction fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term > -0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising) drive negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations without immediate growth support.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
